intended_object: The zero (trivial) subcomodule {0} of a right C-comodule M over a coalgebra C over a commutative semiring R, i.e. the bottom element of the lattice of subcomodules. Inferred from the docstring and the name `bot`.
explanation: In this library a `Subcomodule` is a submodule together with a right-comodule structure on it, plus the condition that the inclusion is colinear. `bot` takes the submodule `⊥ = {0}` and gives it the zero coaction. Because `⊥` is a subsingleton, `⊥ ⊗ C` is zero, so the zero map is the only possible coaction. Coassociativity, counitality and colinearity of the inclusion then hold trivially: both sides are evaluated at m = 0, where every linear map gives 0. So this is the standard zero subcomodule, at the same generality as the library's comodules (any coalgebra over a commutative semiring), which is the natural one. I searched Mathlib for "Comodule" and found nothing, so there is no counterpart there.
